successBar: Every shipped state is derived from live source truth and fails closed when evidence is absent.
No credential value is printed, copied into a fixture, or moved into another public file.
Every deployment command is target-bound and dry-run testable.
Every item adds direct behavioral verification, not report-only freshness.

premiseVerification.method: Live source, workflow, test, generated-artifact, release-gate, and gateway-safe capability inspection.
premiseVerification.primaryGeniusList: Exhausted: cache regenerated with zero ranked items.

items.title: Remove tracked privileged credentials and make every public gate detect the class
items.evidence: Three tracked internal migration/setup files contain privileged database or service credentials. The current full-tree scanner returns zero because PostgreSQL URI credentials, shorter privileged JSON Web Tokens, Python files, and already-committed content are outside overlapping gate coverage.
items.recipe: Remove private migration/setup procedures from the public tree; expand working-tree, history, and public-sanitization detection with redacted PostgreSQL URI, password assignment, and decoded privileged-token classification; add Python coverage; run a non-writing full tracked-tree scan in launch verification; ship a redacted rotation/history-remediation request through Ark.
items.timeToFirstValue: The next local or continuous-integration run blocks the credential class that is currently invisible.

L1.recipe: Remove values and add focused scanner patterns.

L2.recipe: L1 plus tracked-tree gate, sanitizer parity, and redacted fixtures.

L3.recipe: L2 plus shared classifier coverage in history scanning and Ark rotation receipt.

items.executionEvidence: Removed three credential-bearing private procedure files plus a divergent deploy shell; shared URI/assignment/privileged-token classifier now gates tracked tree, history, and sanitizer. Current tree is clean; five fully redacted historical findings remain explicitly queued for rotation/history remediation.

items.title: Make unknown telemetry impossible to render as healthy
items.evidence: The dashboard defaults absent sync diagnostics to an empty object and maps the result to Clean/caught-up. AI-event query errors collapse to an empty successful set, so unavailable telemetry renders as zero and normal.
items.recipe: Introduce provenance-bearing loading, unknown, healthy, and degraded states for sync and AI telemetry. Only affirmative receipts may render green; errors retain a redacted reason and retry path. Add component and model tests for absent, loading, failed, empty-success, queued, and saved states.
items.timeToFirstValue: Operators stop mistaking missing evidence for a healthy system.

L1.recipe: Add explicit unknown/degraded state to the snapshot model.

L2.recipe: L1 plus provenance, timestamp, retry, and component tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus freshness decay and a self-validating state contract.

items.executionEvidence: Sync and AI telemetry now expose loading/unknown/healthy/degraded receipts; missing and failed queries cannot render green. Four focused observability tests pass.

items.title: Gate production deployment on an immutable preflight attestation
items.evidence: The Pages workflow uploads and deploys before production verification. A later red job reports failure only after the artifact is live, while the workflow omits the repo's full local launch gate.
items.recipe: Split the workflow into preflight, deploy, and post-deploy jobs. Preflight runs the exact launch-local gate, builds once, emits an artifact plus commit-bound attestation, and deploy depends on it. Preserve post-deploy probes as rollback signals; never claim staging exists when only local staging is available.
items.timeToFirstValue: A failing source or policy gate can no longer reach production.

L2.recipe: Split jobs and pass the built artifact between them.

L3.recipe: L2 plus commit-bound attestation and deterministic workflow tests.

items.executionEvidence: Pages deployment is a preflight → artifact+attestation → deploy → post-deploy DAG. Attestation binds commit, tree digest, file count, and required gate receipts; workflow/attestation regressions pass.

items.title: Replace mutable-link Supabase commands with one target-locked deploy orchestrator
items.evidence: Package commands disagree: one function command pins the PromoGrind project while aggregate and daily-brief commands rely on mutable local link state and deploy different function sets.
items.recipe: Create a dry-run-first Node orchestrator with a single function manifest, explicit PromoGrind project reference on every command, target mismatch refusal, gateway-only token resolution for apply mode, and redacted receipts. Make package scripts delegate to it; do not deploy during repository validation.
items.timeToFirstValue: Every future deploy preview proves its exact target and function set before credentials are touched.

L1.recipe: Pin every existing package command and unify the function list.

L2.recipe: L1 plus dry-run orchestrator and mismatch tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus gateway resolution and redacted deployment receipt schema.

items.executionEvidence: All package deploy entrypoints delegate to one dry-run-first gateway-resolved orchestrator pinned to fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp. Target mismatch and manifest regressions pass; no deployment was performed.

items.title: Stop generated launch mirrors from cloning one prose status into independent greens
items.axis: observability / source of truth / token reduction
items.evidence: The project-status mirror copies one free-text launch-gate status into smoke, browser-smoke, and build cells; loose substring parsing can classify negated text as passing. The launch-proof mirror catches malformed source and writes an empty proof set without check mode.
items.recipe: Use strict command-addressed testing-surface receipts with enum state, exit code, observed time, and commit. Unknown or stale commands remain unknown. Make both mirrors share fail-closed validation, atomic output, and --check behavior; add them to integrity and deploy triggers.
items.timeToFirstValue: Browser launch state becomes evidence-addressed instead of prose-inferred.

L1.recipe: Tighten parsing and fail malformed launch proof input.

L2.recipe: L1 plus command-addressed receipt matching and --check.

L3.recipe: L2 plus shared generator helper, freshness, commit binding, and adversarial tests.

items.executionEvidence: Both generated mirrors now share strict receipt-addressed parsing, atomic writes, schema validation, and --check. Negated prose and missing commands remain unknown.

items.title: Make marketing consent affirmative, versioned, and reversible
items.evidence: Signup initializes marketing opt-in to true in both UI and auth helper while public policy describes newsletter mail as opt-in.
items.recipe: Default to false; store consent version, source, granted/revoked timestamps separately from transactional mail; expose an account control that can grant or revoke without affecting authentication. Add policy and round-trip tests.
items.timeToFirstValue: New accounts no longer receive marketing consent without an affirmative action.

L1.recipe: Default both UI and helper to false.

L2.recipe: L1 plus versioned provenance and tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus reversible profile control and receipt feedback.

items.executionEvidence: Signup defaults off; consent is versioned, sourced, timestamped, reversible in Profile, and emits trust receipts. Second-order send-boundary enforcement rejects legacy newsletter metadata.

items.title: Compile and test the complete Edge Function surface in continuous integration
items.evidence: Continuous integration tests only one Edge Function test directory, missing a real shared privacy test outside it, and never type-checks every function entry point.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic edge verification script that discovers all tests and index files, runs the complete Deno test surface, type-checks every entry point, and self-tests discovery without network execution. Wire it into continuous integration and launch-local where Deno is available.
items.timeToFirstValue: A misplaced test or uncompilable function can no longer remain invisible to continuous integration.

L2.recipe: L1 plus compile all function entry points.

L3.recipe: L2 plus deterministic discovery manifest and regression test.

items.executionEvidence: CI and launch-local discover and typecheck all 15 Edge entrypoints and execute all 5 test files. The sweep exposed and fixed five real type errors; 43 Deno tests pass.

items.title: Replace pointer-only pseudo-checkboxes with one keyboard-native toggle contract
items.evidence: Two visible controls use clickable div role=checkbox without focusability or keyboard handlers although a correct precedent exists elsewhere.
items.recipe: Extract a native button-based accessible toggle with pressed/checked semantics, visible focus, and stable styling; replace both pseudo-checkboxes and add keyboard/focus regressions plus a source invariant.
items.timeToFirstValue: Keyboard and switch-device users can operate both controls.

L2.recipe: Use native controls and focused component tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus shared toggle and no-pseudo-checkbox invariant.

items.executionEvidence: Pointer-only div checkboxes were replaced by a shared native button switch used across routine, calculator, and consent controls; source invariant passes.

items.title: Publish a fail-closed agent capability catalog derived from real availability
items.axis: AI intelligence / dual audience / public claims
items.evidence: agents.json publishes policy and rights but no tool schemas or availability. Public copy describes live scanning while the feature defaults off and the component renders unavailable.
items.recipe: Generate a versioned calculator/agent capability catalog with inputs, outputs, provenance, limits, prohibitions, and source-only/staging/live state from the same launch and feature sources. Link it from agents.json and llms.txt; make public claim tests reject live-tense claims for unavailable capabilities.
items.timeToFirstValue: Humans and agents see what is actually executable instead of inferring capability from marketing prose.

L1.recipe: Add availability and capability links to agents.json.

L2.recipe: Generate calculator schemas and source-derived states.

L3.recipe: L2 plus contract vectors, public-claim lint, and drift checks.

items.executionEvidence: agents.json and llms.txt link a deterministic capabilities.json generated from calculator, launch-proof, and default-flag truth. Unproved deployment exposes zero callable tools and live scanner copy now states activation is pending.

innovationReserve: Unify credential classifiers across working-tree, history, and public-sanitization gates.
Bind release attestations to commit and artifact digests so post-deploy receipts can prove lineage.
Expose consent and telemetry provenance as user-visible trust receipts.
Make generated agent capabilities self-test against calculator vectors.

skipped.title: Activate Obelisk as the primary identity plane
skipped.reason: Premise verified, but activation without a server verifier, replay/expiry contract, account-linking semantics, and live identity capability would ship a broken security façade. Record as an honest follow-up, not a checkbox implementation.

skipped.title: Self-service remote account deletion
skipped.reason: Premise verified; safe deletion requires an explicit remote retention/cascade contract and deployed authenticated function. Local export/clear/undo already exists, so a shallow UI-only deletion button would be deceptive.

skipped.title: Static public-page theme parity
skipped.reason: Valid design debt, but generator/template ownership must be resolved first to avoid hand-editing one hundred pages that regeneration would overwrite.

skipped.title: Missing baseline legal, agent, theme, bundle, and launch-proof surfaces
skipped.reason: Disproven by live files and tests; these are refinement gaps, not missing systems.

notes: All nine verified items shipped at L3 with behavioral gates. No production deployment or fabricated proof occurred. Current-tree credential exposure is removed; historical findings and external launch proofs remain explicit remediation/launch deferrals.
